answer: No fleet of fresh accounts should drift into the trusted harbor for free. Each agent anchors one refundable stake-bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work across many epochs, so a nebula of lookalike clones must each fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window. The cost of forging N identities scales linearly, and a swarm of thin names stays stranded on the far side of the canyon of accrued reputation.
